summary: Elevate your analytics expertise with our Statistics training. Learn key concepts and techniques to leverage data effectively in business and data science.
lede: Statistics for Data Science and Business Analytics builds a practical foundation for turning data into defensible decisions. You will learn to assess data quality, understand distributions, quantify uncertainty, test claims, model relationships, and interpret practical significance across business contexts. Through reproducible notebooks and small datasets, you will apply tools including pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, SciPy, and statsmodels. The course connects statistical findings to business KPIs while developing skills in sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, regression, classification metrics, model diagnostics, and clear communication of limitations.
audienceIntro: Statistics for data science suits professionals who already work with business data and need stronger analytical judgment, model interpretation, and evidence-based communication.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with spreadsheets, business metrics, or basic data analysis. Familiarity with averages, percentages, charts, and introductory probability will help. No advanced mathematics or programming background is required, but you should be comfortable reading simple Python code. Coding is not required for completion because the course uses guided notebooks and templates, although optional Python practice is included. Advanced topics such as logistic regression, bootstrap resampling, time-series forecasting, and AI-assisted analysis are taught at operational application level rather than production engineering level.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
